data.name: Araz
data.gender_notes: Araz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ar-ra-za, meaning 'to exalt, to make noble, to be high in rank'. This name is often given to children in the hope that they will grow up to be virtuous, wise, and respected members of society. The name Araz carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Araz usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes a sense of nobility, dignity, and respect.
data.etymology: Araz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Araz total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عرض
in_arabic.long_meaning: العرض هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عرض' الذي يعني الحدود أو الحافة. في اللغة العربية، العرض يطلق على الخط أو الحافة التي تفصل بين شيئين. وفي بعض الأحيان، يستخدم العرض كمرادف للعرض أو الظهور. في الثقافة الإسلامية، قد يكون للاسم دلالات مختلفة تعتمد على السياق الذي يستخدم فيه.

in_urdu.name: عرض
in_urdu.meaning: عرض کا مطلب ہے حد یا کنارہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عرض ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حد یا کنارہ۔ اردو میں، عرض کا استعمال حدود یا حاشیہ کے معنی میں کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں مختلف دلالات رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، جہاں یہ حدود یا علاحدگی کے تصور سے منسلک ہو سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अरज़
in_hindi.meaning: अरज़ का अर्थ है सीमा या किनारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरज़ एक नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा में हुई है। इसका अर्थ है सीमा या किनारा। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर एक विभाजन या पृथकता के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है। यह नाम व्यक्ति की पहचान और उनके चरित्र के पहलुओं को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: اراز
in_pashto.meaning: اراز معنی دے حد یا څنډ

in_english.name: Araz
in_english.meaning: Araz means boundary, edge, or limit
in_english.long_meaning: The name Araz is derived from the Arabic root 'عرض' (arḍ), meaning boundary, edge, or limit. In Islamic tradition, this name may signify a physical or metaphorical boundary. Historically, the name Araz has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing separation, distinction, or demarcation. It carries connotations of strength, resilience, and determination.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures, the name Araz is associated with individuals of high rank and prestige. Names often serve as an expression of one's hopes and aspirations for their child. By giving a child the name Araz, parents are essentially wishing for their child to grow up to be a person of nobility and esteem in their community. Moreover, this name has a strong connection to the Arabic language and its rich cultural heritage, which can instill a strong sense of pride and identity in the child.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Araz reflects the importance of striving for personal growth and excellence. It serves as a reminder to constantly seek knowledge, wisdom, and virtue, in order to ascend to higher levels of spiritual awareness and understanding. The name inspires one to aspire towards greatness in both worldly and spiritual pursuits, and to never settle for mediocrity. Additionally, the name Araz can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic concept of tawheed, or the oneness of God, as it reminds us that all of us are equal in the eyes of God, and that true greatness lies in our relationship with Him.
